topic: Ibn al-Haytham (about 965-1040 CE), working in Cairo, showed that we see because light enters the eye, and used a dark room with a small hole (camera obscura) that makes an upside-down picture. His Book of Optics was later translated into Latin.

episode.title: Ibn al-Haytham: Tasveer Ulti Kyun Hai?

shots.narration: ارے، یہ باہر کا منظر اندر الٹا کیسے آگیا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film 3D animation, dark workshop with an upside-down image of a sunlit courtyard on the opposite wall, no visible text.
shots.action: Hamza tilts his head at the upside-down courtyard image.
shots.mood: Intriguing blue shadows with a friendly amber lantern glow.

shots.narration: نوری حمزہ کو پرانے قاہرہ کی سیر کراتا ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm library opening into a projected historical Cairo courtyard with stone arches and colourful awnings, no signs or lettering.
shots.action: Noori projects a glowing view of historical Cairo around Hamza.
shots.mood: Welcoming golden light and gentle wonder.

shots.narration: [excited] یہ ابن الہیثم ہیں، روشنی کو سمجھنے میں مصروف!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected Cairo workshop with brass tools; Ibn al-Haytham appears as a respectful small cartoon figure viewed from behind at a distant table, no text.
shots.action: Noori projects Ibn al-Haytham examining a beam of sunlight.
shots.mood: Quiet curiosity in warm workshop lighting.

shots.narration: اس اندھیرے کمرے میں باہر کا منظر کیسے دکھے گا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, dark demonstration room with a fully covered window and an empty pale opposite wall, no text.
shots.action: Hamza looks toward the empty wall.
shots.mood: Gentle puzzlement with soft blue shadows.

shots.narration: کھڑکی کے پردے میں بس ایک چھوٹا سوراخ ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of an opaque window covering with one tiny circular opening, sunlit courtyard beyond, no text.
shots.action: Noori lifts a small flap to uncover the tiny hole.
shots.mood: Anticipation around a bright pinpoint of sunlight.

shots.narration: [whispers] دیکھو، سوراخ سے روشنی اندر آرہی ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, side view of the dark room, tiny window hole on one side and pale wall opposite, subtle dust revealing incoming light, no text.
shots.action: Hamza follows the incoming light with his pointing finger.
shots.mood: Hushed discovery with delicate golden light.

shots.narration: سیدھی چلتی روشنی سوراخ سے گزر کر الٹی تصویر بناتی ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear cutaway of a dark room beside a sunlit courtyard tree; two illustrative light paths cross at the tiny hole, connecting the tree top to the image bottom and tree bottom to image top, no arrows or text.
shots.action: An upside-down image of the courtyard tree forms on the opposite wall.

shots.narration: ابن الہیثم نے دکھایا، روشنی آنکھ میں آئے تو ہمیں دکھتا ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, simple projected side-view demonstration of a lit brass bowl and an eye, with light travelling from the bowl toward the eye, no labels or text.
shots.action: Noori projects light travelling from the bowl into the eye.
shots.mood: Friendly clarity with soft amber highlights.

shots.narration: [excited] سمجھ آگیا، یہ تو روشنی کا کمال ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, dark workshop with the upside-down courtyard image clearly visible on the wall, no text.
shots.action: Hamza beams at the upside-down image.
shots.mood: Joyful understanding in warm lantern light.

shots.narration: انہوں نے روشنی پر کتاب المناظر بھی لکھی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected historical desk with a closed leather-bound manuscript and brass instruments; Ibn al-Haytham sits far behind it with his back to the viewer, no visible writing.
shots.action: Noori illuminates the closed manuscript with a soft spotlight.

shots.narration: بعد میں یہ کتاب لاطینی زبان میں بھی ترجمہ ہوئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, library table with two differently bound closed manuscript volumes, entirely plain covers without symbols or letters.
shots.action: Noori projects a second manuscript beside the first.
shots.mood: Hopeful golden light celebrating shared knowledge.

shots.narration: [excited] مگر پرانے زمانے میں ستاروں کی جگہ کیسے ناپتے تھے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm library beneath a projected starry sky, an unmarked brass astronomical instrument on the table, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Hamza points toward the projected stars.
shots.mood: Inviting wonder with deep blue stars and warm brass reflections.

episode.endHook: Purane zamane mein log sitaron ki jagah kaise naapte thay?
episode.description: حمزہ اور نوری کے ساتھ قاہرہ میں ابن الہیثم کے تجربے کو دیکھیں۔ جانیں کہ روشنی آنکھ میں کیسے آتی ہے اور اندھیرے کمرے میں الٹی تصویر کیسے بنتی ہے۔
